_lessonPricingNote: The single source for what a lesson costs. The fee is a property of the lesson, not of the package -- it is the same in all three -- so it is quoted once here and read by the packages section and by the fees answer in data/faq.json, which carries {{onlinePrice}} / {{faceToFacePrice}} / {{lessonDuration}} tokens instead of the numbers. Change a price here and both move together.
